Commentary.Commentary: That is it then from this game and it is England and New Zealand who are the first two teams to get on the points table in the Super 12s. The action in the T20 World Cup continues on Super Sunday, the 23rd of October with another doubleheader. In the first game of the day, Sri Lanka will take on Ireland in Hobart and that game will begin at 9.30 am IST (4 am GMT). The second game is a clash between arch-rivals India and Pakistan at the M.C.G in Melbourne and will begin at 1.30 pm IST (8 am GMT). The build-up for both those games will begin much sooner. Do join us then. Cheers!

English skipper, Jos Buttler says that coming into a big tournament like this, there are a few nerves but to get a win in the first game is fantastic. Adds that the fielding was brilliant and it is a crucial area of the game. Mentions that Mark Wood is very important with his pace and he has done really well coming back from his injury. Tells that Sam Curran has a great attitude and takes on the responsibility himself in tough stages and demands the ball. Says that they could have been more fluid with the chase but credits the Afghan bowlers for their effort.

Mohammad Nabi, the captain of Afghanistan says that it was not a good start but they tried their best and played some good cricket. Adds that they failed to put runs on the board and that England are one of the best T20 sides out there but applauds the efforts of his teammates. Mentions that the opposition took a few brilliant catches and they wanted to get to 140-150 but it wasn't meant to be. Says that their plan is to put a decent total on board and they have experienced spinners who have played in Australia and they can use that to their advantage. Ends by saying that they will try to improve upon their mistakes in the next game.

Sam Curran (3.4-0-10-5) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his exceptional bowling display. Curran says that the Afghan team made the chase a bit tricky with their world-class spinners but it feels good to get over the line. Adds that all the teams here have a chance and they have seen in the group stages with West Indies missing out. Mentions that this win will give them confidence and they hope to continue that in the upcoming games. Tells that he is trying to be better in different phases of the game with the ball and is enjoying his cricket.
The Presentation ceremony...

Eariler in the game, Jos Buttler won the toss and put Afghanistan into bat which turned out to be the correct decision. Mark Wood bowled with venom inside the Powerplay and then the others were able to build on it. It was Sam Curran though who stood out with the ball as he picked up the first-ever five-wicket haul by an English player in the T20 World Cup. Ibrahim Zadran was the only one who could muster up valuable runs for Afghanistan. What should have been a straightforward chase for England was made into a bit of a contest by the Afghanistan bowlers. Liam Livingstone however ensured that the boundaries were found and stayed till the end to see his side home.

At the halfway stage Afghanistan seemed down and out but Fazalhaq Farooqi gave it his all in the Powerplay and was able to pick up a wicket. After that, the trio of spinners, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Rashid Khan and Mohammad Nabi took charge in the middle phase and picked up wickets at regular intervals. With the depth of the opposition batting, Afghanistan needed to get all 10 wickets which did not happen and a couple of dropped catches cost them the game. They will however take a lot of positives back from this game.

With 113 runs needed for victory, Jos Buttler and Alex Hales got England off to a steady start before Buttler fell. Hales got out soon after and Dawid Malan was left to do the re-building job. Malan never got going and the wickets kept on tumbling. It was Liam Livingstone who took on the Afghan bowlers every now and then and got the crucial boundaries. In the end, it was a fairly low score to chase down and England managed to escape unscathed. They will look to improve their batting though in the next game.

Not the most convincing of batting displays by England but they have got the job done and have picked up a couple of crucial points to begin their campaign. Afghanistan fought valiantly but with just 112 runs on the board, it was always going to be difficult.

A bit of an anticlimax but England will take it! Azmatullah Omarzai bangs in a bouncer, on middle and on off, Moeen Ali lets it through to the keeper. The umpire calls it a wide for height and that is the winning run. ENGLAND WIN BY 5 WICKETS!
SCORES LEVEL! This is short and on middle, Liam Livingstone skips down the track and pulls it towards deep square leg for a run.
Floated, full and on leg, Moeen Ali slogs it with the inner half towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Short and on off, angling in, Moeen Ali pushes it towards cover.
Darts this one full and on leg, Moeen Ali misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Short and on off, Moeen Ali cuts it wide of deep point for a brace. England now one hit away from victory.
Another seam-up delivery, on middle, skids through, Liam Livingstone looks to cut it but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery, touch fuller and on off, Liam Livingstone drives it uppishly towards cover but it falls short of the fielder and he lets it through too. Two runs taken!
Sharp bouncer! Fazalhaq Farooqi bangs in a bouncer, on leg, Moeen Ali ducks under it. England need 9 more runs to win now in 18 balls.
This is pitched up, on leg, Liam Livingstone tucks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
An off-cutter now, on a length and on off, turning away, Liam Livingstone taps it towards backward point.
Fazalhaq Farooqi lands this short and on middle, Moeen Ali pulls it through square leg for another run.
A slower one, on a length and on middle, Liam Livingstone works it with the inner half towards square leg for a run.
Short of a length and on middle, Moeen Ali pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Quicker, short and on off, Moeen Ali cuts it to deep point for a single. With that, 100 comes up for England and they need 14 runs to win now.
On middle, eased down to long on for one more by Liam Livingstone.
Flatter one, outside off, this is cut away behind point for just a single.
Full and on the pads, flicked away towards square leg.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Harry Brook tries to take on Rashid but holes out! Rashid Khan tosses it up, full and on leg, Harry Brook looks to heave it across the line but hits it with the toe end of his bat and it goes straight in the air and towards long on where Ibrahim Zadran takes a comfortable catch. England five down now!
Commentary.Howout: c Ibrahim Zadran b Rashid Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Short and on middle, Harry Brook pulls it wide of long on for a brace.
Short and around off, this is guided down to third man for a run. Just 18 needed now off 30 balls.
A slight fumble and two runs are taken. This is short and over middle and leg, Harry Brook pulls it away towards the backward square leg fence for another brace.
Good length, around off, this is punched on the up and wide of the fielder at third man for a couple of runs.
Back of a length, over middle, Liam Livingstone manages to guide it away to the right of third man  for a single.
FOUR! Thrashed away! Short and wide, a real loosener from Fareed Ahmad. Livingstone hangs back and just slaps it behind point for a boundary.
MISFIELD AND FOUR! Around off, Liam Livingstone strokes it away towards extra cover but the fielder over there lets it through his hands and the ball speeds away to the fence.
Fareed Ahmad is back on. 9 runs and a wicket from his first over.
Flatter delivery, on leg, angling in, Harry Brook looks to flick it away but misses and the ball loops off his pads to the off side.
Harry Brook walks out to bat now.

OUT! TAKEN! My word, Mohammad Nabi has taken a blinder of a catch and Afghanistan pick up their fourth wicket. This is tossed up, around off, Dawid Malan sees and opportunity and goes for the booming drive. Malan connects it well but plays it uppishly. Nabi at short cover has almost no time to react but manages to go for it with both hands to his right and the ball just sticks. Malan goes after a slow knock and England have to re-build once again.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Nabi b Mujeeb Ur Rahman

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker one, short and angling across. Dawid Malan plays it out off the back foot.
Short and around the pads, tucked away towards square leg for a run.

NOT OUT! Worth a shout but Liam Livingstone survives. This is on a fuller length from Mujeeb Ur Rahman and sliding into the pads. Livingstone leans on and looks to flick it away. Livingstone ends up playing all over it and gets pinged on the pads. There is an appeal for lbw but it is turned down. The decision is reviewed but Ball Tracking confirms that the ball is missing the stumps.
Review time! Afghanistan have taken a review for a LBW decision.
FOUR! A real giveaway by Mujeeb and that will release all the pressure. Shorter and around the hips, Liam Livingstone just guides it fine and the ball runs away into the fine leg fence.
Nabi floats this one full and onto the pads, Dawid Malan looks to flick it away but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Flatter again, around off and this is just knocked down to long on for a run.

Nabi feels there was a run-out chance there. Flatter and close to the off pole, Malan plays it late and towards the gully region for a quick single. The fielder over there fails to collect the ball cleanly and the batters cross with ease.
This is short and on off, Liam Livingstone pulls it in front of mid-wicket for a single.
A bit of flight this time around, Livingstone steps down the track and works it towards wide long on for a couple of runs.
Full and around off, at 100 clicks, Liam Livingstone drives it right back towards the bowler.
Around off, Liam Livingstone walks towards the ball and pushes it back past the bowler for just another single.
Around middle, Malan works it in front of square on the leg side and collects a single.
BEATEN! Fuller length, close to the off stump. Malan once again looks to play it off the back foot but the ball just slides across and goes past the outside edge.
Angling into the pads, Livingstone turns it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Quicker one, on a nagging length and around middle and leg. Dawid Malan gets onto the back foot and flicks it away through mid-wicket for a run.
Around off, Liam Livingstone leans forward and drives it down to long on for a single.
Slows it down a touch and bowls it outside off. Malan leans on and just keeps it out on the off side.
Quicker one, full and swerving away from around off. Liam Livingstone drives it towards deep cover for just a single.
Liam Livingstone comes out to the middle now.

OUT! TIMBER! Straight through the gate! Ben Stokes looks to step down the track but Mohammad Nabi sees him coming. Nabi spears this one into middle stump at 104 clicks and Stokes just walks past the ball. The ball clips the pads and castles into the off pole. England lose their third wicket and Afghanistan are still handing on here. 48 needed now off 56 balls.
Nabi keeps it shorter and on the pads, this is worked away towards square leg for yet another single. England just milking the spinners at the moment.
Shorter and at the body, Ben Stokes hangs back and works it towards mid-wicket for one more.
Speared into the pads, Dawid Malan flcisk it in front of the square on the leg side for a single.

Drinks break! With just 51 runs needed off 60 deliveries, England are still in the driving seat. Afghanistan though have managed to keep the scoring rate down to almost run-a-ball and have picked up a couple of wickets as well. The English batting line up is long and their main target will be to get the win with maximum deliveries remaining. Afghanistan need 2 or 3 quick wickets to just creep back into the game and make things nervous for the opposition. Also, Mohammad Nabi to bowl after the break.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Ben Stokes blocks it down the pitch.
Rashid Khan continues with his shorter length, on middle this time, Dawid Malan works it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short and on off again, played towards extra cover.
Another googly, short and on off, turning away, Dawid Malan pushes it towards extra cover.
Flatter, full and on leg, Dawid Malan tickles it towards short fine leg.
Rashid Khan bowls the googly, short and on off, Dawid Malan moves back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
Rashid Khan comes in from the opposite end now.
Length ball, angling down leg. Dawid Malan flicks it away to fine leg for a run.
FIVE WIDES! A mile high off the deck that one. Fareed Ahmad bangs this one halfway down the track and outside off. The ball goes way over the keeper's head and into the fence.
Back of a length, around the body, Stokes nudges it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Ben Stokes walks in at number 4.

OUT! TAKEN! Fareed Ahmad strikes and gets his first wicket! He bangs it in short delivery, on leg, Alex Hales goes for the pull shot but fails to transfer his weight on his back foot and also gets hurried with the extra bounce. As a result, he cannot get the right connection and hits it in the air towards deep square leg where Fazalhaq Farooqi settles under it and completes a nice catch. England lose their second wicket.
Commentary.Howout: c Fazalhaq Farooqi b Fareed Ahmad

Commentary.Commentary: On a length and on middle, Dawid Malan helps it towards fine leg for a single.
Full again and on off, Dawid Malan drives it but straight to cover.
Fareed Ahmad starts with a fuller delivery, on middle and leg, Alex Hales flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Just the one over then for Rashid Khan as he is replaced by Fareed Ahmad.
Darts this one down the leg, Dawid Malan misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards short fine leg.

DROPPED! This is shorter in lenght and on off, Alex Hales slaps it aerially towards the right of long off where the skipper Mohammad Nabi gets to it but spills it. Afghanistan need to improve their fielding. A single is taken as well.
Slower through the air, on middle, Dawid Malan eases it towards long on for a single.
Short again and on outside off, Alex Hales cuts it towards deep point for a another one.
A bit short and on middle, Dawid Malan pushes it off his back foot towards long off for a run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Dawid Malan chips it over extra cover wide of deep point for a brace.
Goes short now and on off, Dawid Malan this time cuts it easily from his back foot towards deep point for a run.
A googly now, full and on off, turning away, Dawid Malan tries to cut it away but misses.
Tossed up, full and on off, Dawid Malan stays there and knocks it back towards the left of the bowler.
Shorter in length and outside off, Dawid Malan moves back and cuts it towards deep point for a brace.
Flatter delivery and outside off, angling away, Dawid Malan looks for the reverse sweep but cannot connect.
Rashid Khan starts with a short delivery, outside off, Alex Hales slaps it down to long on for a single.
Spin from both ends as Rashid Khan is brought into the attack now.
Floated, full and on leg, Dawid Malan strokes it towards mid on. England are 40/1 at the end of the Powerplay.
Fires in a full delivery, outside off, Dawid Malan looks to cut it but misses.
Shortish and on middle, Alex Hales eases it towards long on for a single.
Quicker and short again, on off, spinning in, Dawid Malan cuts it towards point for a single and gets off the mark.
Shorter and on leg, Alex Hales pulls it off his back foot wide of deep sqaure leg where the fielder covers the ground and dives to his right to stop it. Three runs taken!
Flatter, short and on middle, angling in, Alex Hales moves back and pushes it back to the bowler.
Dawid Malan walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Fazalhaq Farooqi does get the breakthrough for Afghanistan and he is all pumped up. This is very full and on leg stump, swinging into the toes. Jos Buttler falls over a bit as he looks to whip it away leg side. Buttler ends up just chipping it with the swing. The ball flies down towards deep mid-wicket where Mujeeb Ur Rahman takes a good catch running to his left. Buttler departs and Afghanistan now have an opening.
Commentary.Howout: c Mujeeb Ur Rahman b Fazalhaq Farooqi

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and over the stumps, Hales dabs it down towards mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length and around off, Hales looks to back away and go over extra cover but is well beaten.
SIX! All the way! Rubbing salt into the wounds now Alex Hales. Pitched up on leg stump, Hales clears the front leg and dispatches it over the wide long on fence for a maximum.

DROPPED! In and out of the fielder's hands! Short of a length and well outside off, Alex Hales slaps it away towards backward point and the substitute fielder, Qais Ahmad over there is a bit late to react. The catch is fumbled and the bowler seems disappointed.
WIDE! Attempted bumper this time but it is down the leg side and a wide is signalled.
Yorker-length delivery, right at the toes and around 140 clicks. Alex Hales just about manages to dif it out.
On the shorter side and around middle, pulled away off the middle of the bat but straight towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, Jos Buttler works it away through square leg and races back for two. He gets there with ease and the bowler isn't impressed with the fielding.
Deliberately lofted by Jos Buttler. A fraction shorter and around off, Buttler lifts this one off the back foot and over wide mid off. The batters come back for the second with ease.
Around off, this is tapped away towards extra cover for a quick run.
Flatter again, around off, kept out by Hales.
Mujeeb starts off with a quicker and flatter one, around middle and leg. Buttler works it behind square on the leg side for one.
Half an appeal for lbw but it is turned down. Fuller in length, swinging into the pads. Alex Hales misses the flick and gets pinged on the pads. Might have been pitching outside leg.
Afghanistan going with spin now as Mujeeb Ur Rahman comes into the attack.
TWO WIDES! Another pacy delivery, full and down the leg side. Jos Buttler looks to flick but misses and the keeper can only make a half stop. The batters manage to scamper through for a run.
A loose shot this time from Buttler. Good length, outside off and angling away at 140 clicks. Buttler doesn't move his feet and tries to play at it but is beaten past the outside edge.
FOUR! Time and again Jos Buttler is finding the fence. Short and wide, Buttler reaches out and manages to get to it before just tapping it in front of square on the off side for a boundary.
Length again, on middle and leg and this time the ball nips into the right-hander. Jos Buttler tucks it away towards square leg.
A bit of yes and no but they do get the easy single in the end. Good length, over off, Hales plays it late and past the diving fielder at backward point for one.
This is full and wide, angling across as well. Alex Hales stays leg side of the ball and tries to reach for it but fails to do so.
Much better from Omarzai. Good length, around the off pole, Jos Buttler just pushes it out onto the off side.
Length ball, outside off, Alex Hales reaches out and plays it towards cover-point for a single.
WIDE! Omarzai hasn't been able to find his rhythm yet. This is full and wide again but is just a bit too wide of the off stump.
Excellent fielding from Hazratullah Zazai. Around the hips, Buttler flicks it away fine but Zazai at short fine leg dives to his right and makes the stop. Just the single then.
Hard length, over middle and off. Buttler tentatively keeps it down on the off side.
FOUR! Lovely timing on that one! Overpitched, around off, Jos Buttler leans on and drives it in between extra cover and mid off for a boundary.
Very full, on off and just shaping away a touch. Alex Hales pushes it out towards mid off and gets off the mark with a quick single.
WIDE! A wayward start from Azmatullah Omarzai. This is full and wide but beyond the tramline outside off and a wide is called.
Azmatullah Omarzai to bowl from the other end.
And again! Length ball, close to the off stump and seaming away. Jos Buttler makes an assured leave and 5 runs come off the first over.
Good length, angling across the right-hander and Buttler just leaves it alone.

BEATEN! Fazalhaq Farooqi serves this one on a nagging length and around middle. Jos Buttler tries to get behind the line but is completely squared up as the ball nips away a long way off the deck and beats the outside edge.
WIDE! A touch fuller but well outside the off stump. Buttler fails to reach it and a wide is called.
Top delivery! Good length, on off stump and the ball seams away beautifully off the deck. Jos Buttler leaves it alone.

FOUR! England and Jos Buttler are underway in fine fashion. A bit too full and a bit too straight as well. Buttler flicks it off the leg stump and gets it in front of the square on the leg side to collect a boundary.
Fazalhaq Farooqi starts off with a fullish delivery, this is served outside off and the ball swings in late. Jos Buttler lets it through to the keeper.
